explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 87 named tracks/releases across Boomkat's September 14 new-release index, Resident Advisor current reviews, Juno's current techno and experimental-electronic windows, official Bandcamp release pages, and targeted persistent-state cross-checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Threat- or panic-coded propositions were not advanced.
Completed Runs 231, 232, 233, 235 and 236 selected identities and boundaries were compared before ranking. The top three boundaries do not repeat those runs.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger. Previously evaluated COW — Dead Air and Velvet, unresolved Arovane — Revart Amx and Nonlin R, unresolved Soichi Terada — Rising Sun Up, and previously requested Shin Watanabe tracks I, VI and X were excluded.

Red Zone Trax III, Red Zone Trax II, Ethos Mama Trax VII, Good Morning, Low Tension (Alternative Version), Voices From Beyond, Purple Haze (Edit), Scapen Te and Cobra are newly ranked exact-title leads, not triggered revisits.
Multiple same-release leads have differentiated individual prose except lower-ranked Cobra, whose evidence gap is explicit. No artist, texture, novelty or genre quota is applied.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
